limitations: The exact global time optimum concerns a two-jump trap-center protocol, not arbitrary control paths or finite-bandwidth hardware.
Initial position and velocity are deterministic zero and the active force is a known constant throughout the pulse.
The Gaussian noise has thermal strength proportional to friction and the global result assumes strictly underdamped positive friction.
The variance comparison is to the unrestricted mean-optimal protocol, not to an unrestricted minimum-variance value.
Preparation, actuation bandwidth and drive-generation costs and publication-priority certification are not included.
scientific_integrity: Full analytic derivation, complete stated domain, explicit literature-based benchmarks, and an independently executable diagnostic checker; no external or independent audit claimed.
title: Half-period universality and high-quality work reliability of a two-jump inertial trap
